messages:
Alice: heads up — DeployBot flagged canary for runtime v2.13.1 in eu-west-1, automatic hold engaged :warning:
DeployBot: Canary rollout halted at 03:14 UTC. 4/20 canary hosts failed healthcheck (OOM on kv-cache). Rolling to HOLD state. Notifying oncall and support channels.
sre-jen: ack. pulling logs now — looks like batch-size interaction with new kernel shim.
Alice: we need a short customer-facing update (statuspage + enterprise note).
support-liz: drafting. Advisory or degraded-service?
Alice: degraded latency and intermittent failures for some customers in eu-west-1. Dedicated customers pinned to v2.13.1 may be impacted — recommend holding them on previous stable.
product-omar: propose offering immediate rollback to v2.12.9-stable and a pinned variant for enterprise. Also suggest mitigation: lower batch size to 1-2.
sre-jen: repro with long sequences + continuous-batching. Hotfix ETA ~2h if kernel patch; rollback ETA ~20m for canary -> rollback.
support-liz: pasting drafts for review:

Statuspage snippet:
Summary: Canary for runtime v2.13.1 in eu-west-1 was paused after elevated memory errors impacted a subset of requests. Impact: increased latency and occasional request failures for some customers in eu-west-1.
Current status: Canary paused; investigating and evaluating rollback/mitigation.
Next update: ~30 minutes or on resolution.

Enterprise email snippet:
Hi {{customer_name}},
We detected a regression in runtime v2.13.1 that may affect inference latency and reliability for some workloads in eu-west-1. Action: We paused the canary and can pin your Dedicated capacity to the previous stable runtime (v2.12.9-stable). Reply to this message to request the hold.
Rollback ETA: ~20 minutes; fix ETA: ~2 hours.
Support — Redwood Inference

Alice: add CLI command for self-serve customers.
support-liz: added: CLI: `redwood runtime set-variant --region eu-west-1 --variant v2.12.9-stable` or contact support.
product-omar: add suggestion to lower batch sizes: `redwood runtime config --batch-size 1`.
sre-jen: ops troubleshooting snippet for oncall:
# Check OOM traces
sudo journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 200 | grep -i oom
# Disable continuous batching temporarily
redwoodctl set-config --service runtime --key continuous_batching --value false --region eu-west-1

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2028; statuspage update requested.
Alice: Support — queue enterprise email to Dedicated customers in eu-west-1 with tag dedicated-eu-west1-impact. Post the sent copy here.
support-liz: queued; will send in ~10m and paste copy when delivered.
DeployBot: Canary hold set to manual only. No automatic progression.
Alice: Engineering — hold full rollout until green canary or explicit rollback decision. If rollback occurs, publish rollback time to customers.
sre-jen: if kernel patch works we’ll re-canary; otherwise full rollback of v2.13.1. ETA update in 30m.
product-omar: add a release-note line about regression and rollback reference in the changelog.
Alice: Support & SRE, update incident timeline when you send updates.
support-liz: statuspage updated and enterprise batch queued (tags attached). Will paste sent email here after delivery.
Alice: leaving thread open for updates — post sent email and rollback actions here :thumbsup:
